sources.name: NC State Extension Gardener Plant Toolbox: Epipremnum aureum
Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, Plants of the World Online: Epipremnum aureum

tr.description: Salon sarmaşığı (potos) bakımı: parlak dolaylı ışık, her sulamadan önce kontrol, çelikle çoğaltma ve ASPCA'nın kedi-köpek kaydı.
tr.imageAlt: Dışarıda bir ağaç gövdesine tırmanan, sarı çizgili kalp biçimli yapraklarıyla salon sarmaşığı
tr.caption: Fotoğraf: Epipremnum aureum, Jenny Saito, iNaturalist üzerinden, CC BY 4.0. Yeniden boyutlandırıldı.

atAGlance.light: Parlak dolaylı ışık; daha az ışığa dayanır ama alacası solabilir
atAGlance.watering: Harcın üst kısmı kuruduğunda ve saksı hafiflediğinde sula
atAGlance.humidity: Normal oda havası; çok kuru odada nemlendirici veya çakıllı tepsi işe yarar
atAGlance.temperature: Ilık oda sıcaklığı; dona dayanıksız tropik bir sarmaşık
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCA kedi ve köpekler için toksik olarak listeler

en.description: Pothos care: bright indirect light, a check before every watering, trailing-stem cuttings and what the ASPCA lists for cats and dogs.
en.imageAlt: Pothos vines with heart-shaped, yellow-streaked leaves climbing a tree trunk outdoors
en.caption: Photo: Epipremnum aureum by Jenny Saito, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Resized.

atAGlance.light: Bright indirect light; tolerates lower light but may lose variegation
atAGlance.watering: Water when the upper part of the mix has dried; the pot feels lighter
atAGlance.humidity: Average room air; a humidifier or pebble tray helps in very dry rooms
atAGlance.temperature: Warm room temperatures; a tropical climber that is not frost-hardy
atAGlance.petSafety: Listed as toxic to cats and dogs by the ASPCA

es.description: Cuidados del potos: luz indirecta brillante, comprobar el sustrato antes de regar, esquejes de tallo y qué dice la ASPCA sobre perros y gatos.
es.imageAlt: Tallos de potos con hojas acorazonadas y vetas amarillas trepando por un tronco al aire libre
es.caption: Foto: Epipremnum aureum de Jenny Saito, vía iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Redimensionada.

atAGlance.light: Luz indirecta brillante; tolera menos luz, pero puede perder el jaspeado
atAGlance.watering: Riega cuando la parte superior del sustrato se ha secado y la maceta pesa menos
atAGlance.humidity: Humedad ambiente normal; en habitaciones muy secas ayuda un humidificador o una bandeja con guijarros
atAGlance.temperature: Temperatura cálida de interior; trepadora tropical que no resiste heladas
atAGlance.petSafety: La ASPCA lo incluye como tóxico para gatos y perros

de.description: Efeutute pflegen: helles indirektes Licht, vor jedem Gießen prüfen, Stecklinge bewurzeln und was die ASPCA zu Katzen und Hunden angibt.
de.imageAlt: Efeutute mit herzförmigen, gelb gestreiften Blättern, die im Freien an einem Baumstamm emporrankt
de.caption: Foto: Epipremnum aureum von Jenny Saito, über iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Verkleinert.

atAGlance.light: Hell, ohne direkte Sonne; verträgt weniger Licht, verliert dann aber oft die Musterung
atAGlance.watering: Gießen, wenn der obere Teil des Substrats abgetrocknet ist und der Topf leichter wirkt
atAGlance.humidity: Normale Raumluft; in sehr trockenen Räumen helfen Luftbefeuchter oder Kiesschale
atAGlance.temperature: Warme Zimmertemperatur; tropische Kletterpflanze, nicht frosthart
atAGlance.petSafety: Von der ASPCA als giftig für Katzen und Hunde geführt

pt.description: Cuidados com a jiboia: luz indireta clara, conferir o substrato antes de regar, mudas por estaca e o que a ASPCA informa sobre cães e gatos.
pt.imageAlt: Ramos de jiboia com folhas em forma de coração e listras amarelas subindo por um tronco ao ar livre
pt.caption: Foto: Epipremnum aureum de Jenny Saito, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Redimensionada.

atAGlance.light: Luz indireta clara; tolera menos luz, mas pode perder o variegado
atAGlance.watering: Regue quando a parte de cima do substrato secar e o vaso estiver mais leve
atAGlance.humidity: Umidade normal da casa; em cômodos muito secos, umidificador ou bandeja com pedrinhas ajuda
atAGlance.temperature: Temperatura amena a quente; trepadeira tropical, não tolera geada
atAGlance.petSafety: A ASPCA lista como tóxica para gatos e cães

fr.description: Entretien du pothos : lumière vive indirecte, vérification avant chaque arrosage, boutures de tige et ce que l’ASPCA indique pour chats et chiens.
fr.imageAlt: Tiges de pothos aux feuilles en cœur striées de jaune grimpant le long d’un tronc en extérieur
fr.caption: Photo : Epipremnum aureum de Jenny Saito, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Redimensionnée.

atAGlance.light: Lumière vive indirecte ; tolère moins de lumière mais peut perdre sa panachure
atAGlance.watering: Arroser quand le haut du substrat a séché et que le pot paraît plus léger
atAGlance.humidity: Air ambiant normal ; humidificateur ou plateau de billes dans une pièce très sèche
atAGlance.temperature: Pièce tempérée à chaude ; liane tropicale qui ne supporte pas le gel
atAGlance.petSafety: Classé toxique pour les chats et les chiens par l’ASPCA

ja.description: ポトスの育て方。明るい間接光、毎回の水やり前の確認、つるの挿し木と、ASPCAによる猫・犬への毒性情報を紹介します。
ja.imageAlt: 屋外の木の幹を登る、黄色い斑のあるハート形の葉を付けたポトスのつる
ja.caption: 写真：Epipremnum aureum、撮影：Jenny Saito。iNaturalistより、CC BY 4.0。サイズ変更済み。

atAGlance.light: 明るい間接光。弱い光にも耐えるが斑が減ることがある
atAGlance.watering: 用土の上部が乾き、鉢が軽くなってから与える
atAGlance.humidity: 通常の室内湿度。とても乾く部屋では加湿器や小石のトレーが役立つ
atAGlance.temperature: 暖かい室温。熱帯のつる植物で霜には耐えられない
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCAは猫・犬に有毒と掲載

ko.description: 스킨답서스 관리: 밝은 간접광, 매번 물주기 전 확인, 늘어진 줄기의 삽목과 고양이·개에 관한 ASPCA 분류를 알아보세요.
ko.imageAlt: 야외 나무줄기를 타고 오르는 스킨답서스 덩굴. 하트 모양 잎에 노란 무늬가 있습니다
ko.caption: 사진: Epipremnum aureum — 촬영: Jenny Saito, iNaturalist 제공, CC BY 4.0. 크기를 조정했습니다.

atAGlance.light: 밝은 간접광. 약한 빛도 견디지만 무늬가 줄어들 수 있습니다
atAGlance.watering: 흙의 윗부분이 마르고 화분이 가벼워졌을 때 물을 주세요
atAGlance.humidity: 일반적인 실내 습도. 매우 건조하면 가습기나 자갈 받침이 도움이 됩니다
atAGlance.temperature: 따뜻한 실내 온도. 서리를 견디지 못하는 열대 덩굴식물입니다
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCA가 고양이와 개에게 유독한 식물로 분류했습니다

it.imageAlt: Tralci di pothos con foglie a cuore striate di giallo che si arrampicano su un tronco all’aperto
it.caption: Foto: Epipremnum aureum di Jenny Saito, tramite iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Ridimensionata.

atAGlance.light: Luce intensa indiretta; tollera meno luce ma può perdere variegatura
atAGlance.watering: Annaffia quando la parte superiore asciuga e il vaso è più leggero
atAGlance.humidity: Normale aria di casa; umidificatore o ciottoli nelle stanze molto secche
atAGlance.temperature: Stanza calda; rampicante tropicale non resistente al gelo
atAGlance.petSafety: Elencato dall’ASPCA come tossico per gatti e cani

it.description: Cura del pothos: luce indiretta, controllo prima dell’acqua, talee dei fusti e informazioni ASPCA per gatti e cani, con problemi comuni.

zh-Hant.imageAlt: 黃金葛心形綠葉帶有黃色斑紋，沿枝條垂下
zh-Hant.caption: 照片： Epipremnum aureum，攝影：Jenny Saito，來源：iNaturalist， CC BY 4.0. 已調整尺寸。

atAGlance.light: 明亮間接光最佳；耐低光，但斑紋可能減少
atAGlance.watering: 上方幾公分乾燥、花盆變輕後澆透並瀝乾
atAGlance.humidity: 一般室內濕度；很乾時可提高濕度
atAGlance.temperature: 溫暖房間；冬季避開冷窗與冷風

zh-Hant.description: 黃金葛照護指南：明亮間接光、介質與盆重檢查、冬季減水、莖插繁殖，以及斑紋消失和對貓狗的毒性。
